title: Cueva Imix - Allison 2014
credits: Cueva Imix, Xpuha, Quintana Roo; surveyed 24 and 29 December 2013 and 2 January 2014 by Stan Allison, Gosia Allison-Kosior, Barbara Luke; drawn by Stan Allison. Length 494 m, depth 7 m (AMCS Activities Newsletter 37, p. 158, 2014)
sistemaWhy: X-pu Ha: the sistema the database files the Xpuha AMCS surveys under. Cueva Imix is the Entrada Imix half of Sistema Dos Amores (Imix + Xibalba, joined later by a 16 m deep dive; AMCS 2015 map, dropped by the user).
wetDry: Shallow water cave: most of the floor is water (pale blue), with dry breakdown and flowstone mounds in the entrance room and the Sala de los Dos Sergio; six sumps (darker blue, 'sifón?'/'sifón!') at the passage ends, not dived. Included by the user's decision.

notWalls: 0.257 black: floor detail (breakdown, rubble, flowstone mounds and their ticked slopes), the ticked dashed drip line of the entrance doline, the cross-sections and their leaders; 0.257 dark grey: stipple (sand); 0.129 dark grey: the water's edge; black fills: stalagmites (triangles) and columns (hourglasses, in white flowstone 'clover' bases); 0.36: scale bar; 1.0: page frame. No survey lines are drawn.

entrances.why: the open doline NW of the ticked dashed drip line, labelled 'Entrada' (Entrada Imix of Sistema Dos Amores); no database cave - Imix is not in the database nor in OpenStreetMap

symbols.why: Vector map: labels are real PDF text (page.get_text), positions in PDF points. build_layer.py doesn't read symbols yet. No depth numbers on the plan (only 'Profundidad 7 m' in the title), no ceiling heights, no flow arrows, no bones (no legend; every small icon checked: black triangles are stalagmites, hourglasses are columns, the white 'clover' outlines around them flowstone bases). The sumps' leads-to are placed on the sumps (darker blue fills), not on their labels.

unverified: No position for any part of this cave: Entrada Imix is not in the database or OpenStreetMap, the sistema X-pu Ha has no position, and no placed map overlaps it (the 1999 Mafia map of Sistema X-pu Ha is the caleta, with no Imix). The single control point below is a NOMINAL anchor (the OpenStreetMap 'XPuha' node, 20.473665 N, 87.257026 W) only so the pipeline can run: the geometry is NOT on the ground. To fix: a field GPS of Entrada Imix (or of Entrada Xibalba, about 245 m SE of Imix on the Dos Amores map).
